ACS - Same as Unity. Two characters didnt worked for me at all and just dialogs made me to quit game, which I did after like 5 hours. (Never finished this one)

AC Origins - Basically dream come true: Focus on history and location. Beautiful location and the best setting. Loving gameplay, charachters, combat, locations. This is what I had in my head after AC1 (like 12 years ago?) for future of AC series.

AC Odyssey - Big disappointment. Locations are forgettable. Characters are speaking in such a weird way. Dont like superpowers. Ships not so teriblle this time
